description: Create a project in Pipedrive. Required: title, board_id, phase_id (see list_pipedrive_project_boards). Pass any additional Pipedrive field in `fields`, keyed by its field key/name (call the matching list_pipedrive_*_fields tool first to discover custom field keys and, for enum/set fields, their option ids). Common fields: description, deal_ids (array), person_id, org_id, owner_id, start_date, end_date.

fields.description: Field values to set (API field name → value)
